text: Huge shoutout to the new e-waste collection drive in Bengaluru! Dropped off 4 old smartphones and 2 dead laptops at the municipal recycling centre today. Smooth process and certified eco-friendly disposal. #EWasteManagement #RecycleIndia

Visited Seelampur informal recycling market today. Alarmed to see workers without any protective gear burning circuit boards over open fires to extract copper. The toxic smoke is devastating for their lungs and Delhi air quality.

Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change has notified updated targets under E-Waste Management Rules 2022. Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) portal now operational for brand registration and annual returns.

Tried to return my defective tablet through brand take-back program under EPR rules. Customer service had zero idea about authorized collection points. Most companies are doing mere greenwashing on e-waste compliance!
Excellent initiative by our local resident welfare association in Pune partnering with an authorized e-waste recycler. Collected over 450 kg of electronic scrap including CRT monitors and printers.
Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) released circular regarding verification of recycling certificates submitted by producers and recyclers under EPR framework for FY 2023-24.

Informal sector kabadiwalas handle more than 90% of India's e-waste without basic safety protocols or minimum wage protection. Formalizing and integrating them into authorized supply chains is an urgent policy need.
Disappointed with the lack of e-waste drop-off bins in tier-2 cities like Lucknow and Kanpur. Where are common citizens supposed to safely discard obsolete lithium-ion batteries and chargers?
Proud of our green technology startup in Hyderabad achieving R2 certified status for responsible electronics refurbishment and precious metal recovery. Circular economy in action!
Why are electronics manufacturers not penalised for non-repairable designs? Soldered RAM and glued batteries intentionally accelerate planned obsolescence and generate massive e-waste piles.
State Pollution Control Board issued show-cause notices to 14 unauthorized scrap dismantlers along the Yamuna floodplain for hazardous heavy metal leaching into groundwater.

Upcoming national conference on Sustainable Electronic Waste Management and Circular Economy scheduled for March 10 at IIT Delhi. Registration link open for environmental researchers and policy makers.
Grateful to see schools in Chennai running e-waste awareness drives! Children are learning about lead and mercury toxicity in discarded electronics and educating their parents on proper segregation.
India generated over 1.6 million tonnes of electronic waste last year according to UN Global E-waste Monitor. We are severely underestimating informal dismantling and hazardous contamination.
Notice: Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai has designated 24 ward-level e-waste collection kiosks open on every Saturday between 9 AM and 5 PM.
Heavy metals like cadmium and hexavalent chromium from discarded printed circuit boards are poisoning soil and drinking water near Moradabad scrap yards. We need strict law enforcement immediately!
Our university campus conducted an old gadget recycling marathon today. Collected 300+ broken cables, chargers, and keyboards for formal recycling. Small steps make a huge difference!
EPR certificate trading system launched by CPCB aims to create market-based incentives for electronic waste collection and scientific recycling across Indian states.
The take-back discount promised by online smartphone retailers for trading old phones is absurdly low, pushing consumers to sell to unregulated informal scrap dealers instead.
Commendable work by NGO Chintan in training Delhi waste pickers on safe handling of electronic waste, providing health checkups and safety equipment.
Guidelines issued for battery waste management rules covering electric vehicle batteries and portable electronics recycling quotas.
Illegal dumping of broken solar panels and inverter batteries spotted near highway drainage in Rajasthan. Zero surveillance and zero accountability from local authorities.
Super impressed by the doorstep e-waste pickup service from an authorized recycling aggregator in Gurugram! On-time pickup, weighing scale, and immediate green recycling certificate issued.
Right to Repair movement in India needs statutory backing. Consumers should have access to spare parts and schematics instead of being forced to dump functioning gadgets when one component fails.
Parliamentary standing committee tabled report on efficacy of E-Waste Management Rules and recommended higher penalties for non-compliant electronics importers.
Informal acid bathing of motherboards to extract gold releases toxic nitrogen oxides and hydrochloric fumes. Workers in Mandoli industrial cluster are suffering severe respiratory disorders.
Organised a corporate e-waste amnesty week at our IT tech park in Bengaluru. Over 2 tonnes of obsolete servers, networking switches, and monitors safely handed over to certified e-waste recyclers.
Why do most electronics retail stores not maintain functional deposit-refund drop boxes as mandated under Central rules? The implementation on the ground is completely missing.
CPCB data indicates formal recycling capacity in India has reached 2.1 million tonnes across 550 registered recycling facilities nationwide.
Heartbroken to see young teenagers dismantling cathode ray tube TVs with hammer without gloves or goggles, inhaling toxic phosphors. Government must eradicate child labour in informal e-waste yards.
Fantastic community workshop on upcycling old PC components into robotic kits for school students! Sustainable thinking combined with STEM education.
Lithium-ion battery fires in informal scrapyards are increasing across Delhi NCR. Without dedicated fire safety standards for battery storage, this is a ticking disaster.
Standard Operating Procedure for inspection of authorized e-waste dismantling facilities released by the State Pollution Control Board.
Brilliant experience exchanging my 7-year-old television for credit at an authorized brand recycling hub in Ahmedabad. Quick, transparent, and eco-friendly.
EPR targets on paper look ambitious, but without verified traceability and barcode tracking of scrap consignments, fraudulent recycling certificates continue to be traded.
Most people in our apartment complex still toss alkaline batteries and earphone wires directly into regular household garbage. Urgent need for civic awareness and doorstep segregation bins.
Interactive webinar on 'Bridging the Formal-Informal Gap in India's E-Waste Ecosystem' will be hosted by Centre for Science and Environment on May 25.
Kudos to the municipal corporation for deploying mobile e-waste collection vans across residential sectors in Noida every Sunday morning!
Open burning of insulation plastic from copper wiring continues unabated in outer fringe colonies of Kanpur. Smog is unbearable and municipal authorities turn a blind eye.
Joint study by Toxics Link reveals over 85% of surveyed consumers in metro cities do not know where the nearest authorized e-waste collection point is located.
New circular business model launched: leasing enterprise laptops and office electronic equipment with guaranteed end-of-life buyback and refurbishment.
Notification regarding revision of threshold limits for lead and mercury content in electrical and electronic equipment under RoHS provisions.
Terrible experience trying to locate an e-waste drop-off bin in Kolkata. The address listed on the official portal led to an abandoned warehouse. Zero accountability!
Inspiring story of a women-led cooperative in Bengaluru converting obsolete electronic components into artistic jewelry and upcycled home decor items.
E-waste recycling startup raises seed funding to set up automated PCB shredding and hydrometallurgical rare-earth metal extraction plant in Gujarat.
Strict penalties must be imposed on international scrap importers smuggling illegal e-waste containers into Indian ports disguised as mixed metal scrap.
Public notice: Annual returns for bulk consumers of electronic equipment for FY 2023-24 must be filed on the EPR portal by June 30.
Really glad that our college campus established a permanent electronic waste depository. We diverted over 800 kg of electronics from landfills this semester alone!
Why are major e-commerce platforms not offering free reverse logistics for recycling when delivering replacement home appliances? Missed opportunity for circularity.
Environmental activists stage demonstration outside regional pollution board demanding immediate remediation of lead-contaminated soil near industrial e-waste sites.
Comprehensive training module on safe dismantling of electric vehicle lithium battery packs introduced for technicians in National Skill Development centres.
Draft amendments to E-Waste Management Rules published in official gazette inviting public comments within 60 days.
So frustrating that authorized recyclers refuse to accept small broken electronic items like USB cables and headphones unless you bring bulk quantities.
Wonderful to see local resident groups organizing weekend repair cafes in Bengaluru to mend broken toasters, mixers, and electronics instead of dumping them into garbage.
Informal scrap dealers are offering higher cash-on-delivery rates for scrap motherboards than authorized recyclers, completely defeating policy takeback targets.
Quarterly review meeting held by Central Pollution Control Board on Extended Producer Responsibility compliance status of consumer electronics brands.
Black smoke and toxic stench from burning discarded plastic casings of computers behind our apartment complex in Ghaziabad. We cannot even open our windows!
Delighted to receive an official green recycling certificate and reward coupons after depositing my old printer at the CPCB registered collection centre.
Producer Responsibility Organisations (PROs) are failing to establish transparent supply chains, operating mostly as certificate brokers without ground-level collection infrastructure.
Schedule for mobile hazardous waste and e-waste collection drives in Kochi municipal wards announced for the month of August.
Extremely impressed by the modern shredding and electrostatic separation machinery at the new recycling plant in Navi Mumbai. Zero landfill discharge achieved!
Children living near informal scrap recycling workshops in Moradabad show blood lead levels four times above WHO safety thresholds. This is an environmental health emergency.
Discussion thread: What do you do with your old smartphones and charging bricks once they stop working? Do you hold onto them or dispose of them?
Fantastic consumer awareness campaign on television explaining how proper recycling saves precious gold, silver, and copper while preventing soil toxicity.
Local municipality launched deposit-refund kiosk where citizens receive 10 rupee bus pass discounts for every certified electronic item deposited.
Fake EPR certificates worth crores detected by enforcement vigilance team; shell companies masquerading as formal dismantlers booked under environmental protection laws.
Summary of guidelines for management and safe disposal of photovoltaic solar panel waste issued by Ministry of New and Renewable Energy.
It is totally unacceptable that tech companies make batteries non-removable. When the battery health degrades after two years, the entire phone becomes electronic junk.
Super happy to see our housing society achieve 100% electronic waste diversion for 6 consecutive months through partnerships with certified green recyclers.
Toxic leachate containing heavy metals detected in borewell water samples within 2 km radius of unlined e-waste dump sites in outskirts of Hyderabad.
List of accredited testing laboratories for hazardous substance testing under Restriction of Hazardous Substances (RoHS) released.
Great progress! Over 100 IT corporations in Gurugram Cyber Hub signed voluntary green charter committing to 100% formal e-waste disposal and asset refurbishment.
Why is there no penalty on local municipal garbage trucks mixing discarded electronic gadgets with organic wet waste? Segregation at source is failing miserably.
International E-Waste Day celebrated across universities in India with student hackathons focused on circular electronics design and component recovery.
Informal scrap dismantlers dumping corrosive battery acid straight into city storm drains. Severe health hazard for sewage workers and aquatic ecosystems.
Survey report indicates corporate compliance with EPR targets increased by 28% year-over-year following digital portal audits by pollution control boards.
Thrilled to volunteer at the e-waste collection drive organized by our community youth club in Bhopal. Collected over 500 gadgets from 120 households!
Unregulated e-waste shredding unit operating without pollution control NOC in residential lane sealed by district magistrate following resident complaints.
Workshop on eco-design guidelines and modular electronic product architecture will be held at Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore next month.
The informal sector should not be criminalized. Instead, policy must provide them with safe recycling parks, protective gear, fair wages, and formal training.
Delighted with the transparent valuation and immediate UPI payment received when exchanging old appliances on a certified circular electronics portal.
Severe air quality alerts triggered in outer industrial clusters due to nocturnal burning of plastic wiring and PVC insulation from scrap electronics.
Guidelines on environmentally sound management of end-of-life telecom equipment and cell tower battery backup systems uploaded on regulatory portal.
Wonderful initiative by high school students creating a web directory of certified e-waste drop-off locations across 15 Indian cities. Youth driving climate action!
Tech brands boast about carbon neutrality in marketing, yet fail to establish a single accessible physical collection bin in entire districts. Hollow greenwashing!
Notice: Central Pollution Control Board extends deadline for filing quarterly electronic waste return for brand producers till December 15.
Heartening to see our city municipal corporation install dedicated electronic scrap deposit bins in all metro stations across Bengaluru. Accessibility is key!
Open dumping of medical electronics and discarded diagnostic devices near river bank in Varanasi poses immense biohazard and heavy metal contamination risks.
Webinar series on sustainable materials, bio-plastics in electronics casing, and design for disassembly starts this Thursday at 4 PM IST.
Celebrated 1 year of our zero-e-waste corporate pledge. Refurbished 400 old employee laptops and donated them to rural government schools with digital learning software.
